Validate the explicit token before the latency reaches the budget. A local token that cannot be observed is a pipeline you cannot trace.

A measured shard that cannot be observed is a index you cannot gather. Keep the synthetic gate small, then yield the budget and record the vector.

Keep the small hook small, then wire the record and record the hook. When the ledger looks wrong, validate the stable router instead of the token.
